name: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk
summary: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk provides herbal medicines, cosmetics, and foods and beverage products in Indonesia. The company operates through three segments: Herbal Medicine and Supplements; Food and Beverage; and Pharmacy. It also offers medicine products comprising ethical/prescriptions and OTCs; herbal products, such as traditional herbals, food and beverages, herbal medicines, supplements, vitamins, and mom, kids, and baby products; and powder and liquid herbal ingredients for ache and pain relief, antibiotics, anemia, anti-allergy, antioxidants, blood pressure, brain function, bone health, children's health, cold, flu, and cough, diabetes, digestion, energy and vitality,…
